description: Read the picks in one of your lists, in reader order, with item ids, 200 at a time unless you pass `limit`. When `nextCursor` is set, pass it as `cursor` for the next page. Call this before update_item or remove_item to get the id you need.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Picks per page, up to 1,000. Defaults to 200.

list.description: Which list: exact slug, handle/slug, or id from a previous result.

name: list_items
title: Open my list for editing
